title: T9 — Project registers (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Project Registers — T9 TOGAF ADM capability

## Risks

No project-owned risk row is recorded for T9; the live risks are the programme's R1–R14 (scope
vs capacity, record theatre, instrument self-deception, transport, shared target, register
staleness, provenance, standard completeness, CI budget, evidence theatre, seed quality and
the quality of the V1 record itself). This section is an explicit absence, not an omission.

## Issues

| Code | Issue | Status |
|---|---|---|
| U3-EXC-T9 | Out-of-sequence closure accepted as a retrospective exception (T9) | accepted |

## Assumptions

The Architecture Board is a live governance body with a published delegation; the ADM profile is
adopted; the artefacts are typed rows bound to the standard's `artifact_type`, not free text.

## Dependencies

T1's plan rows, T3's PM job and T10's tranche reviews are adjacent contracts, not this slice;
T10 and T12 depend on this capability's gates.

## Benefits

T9 owns no benefit profile; the capability is the control surface the programme's design gates
and waivers rest on. The benefit status is carried by U6's profiles.

## Changes

The retrospective lifecycle-record change is recorded separately in this batch
(`Complete T9's retrospective lifecycle record`, approved by a distinct approver under the
standing delegation) so the change-control artefact resolves. The out-of-sequence closure is
the accepted issue above, not a change.
